name: Allen Cooper AC-1156 Low Ankle Steel Toe Industrial Safety Shoes
shortDescription: ISI-certified low-ankle safety shoes with 200J impact steel toe cap, genuine split leather upper, and double-density antistatic oil-resistant PU sole.
overview: The Allen Cooper AC-1156 is one of India's most trusted industrial safety shoes, purpose-engineered for heavy manufacturing, fabrication shops, and construction environments. Featuring an anatomically contoured broad steel toe cap tested to withstand 200 Joules of drop impact and 15 kN of compression, it provides unyielding toe protection. The upper is crafted from breathable, genuine buff Barton split leather, while the direct-injected dual-density polyurethane (PU) sole provides antistatic properties, exceptional oil and acid resistance, and deep multi-directional cleats for surefooted slip resistance on slick workshop floors.
keyFeatures: 200 Joules impact-resistant carbon steel toe cap conforming to IS 15298 (Part 2)
Genuine breathable buff grain split leather upper with padded ankle collar
Direct injected double density PU sole provides superior shock absorption
Antistatic and oil, acid, and mild alkali resistant tread pattern
Sweat-absorbing moisture-wicking Cambrelle lining prevents foot odor and blistering
Rust-resistant brass eyelets with heavy-duty polyester round laces
Energy-absorbing heel zone (20 Joules) reducing fatigue during 12-hour shifts
